# Rule 9 - Don't Be Excessively Incompetent
Everyone is bad at the game at some point. Everyone is new, and learning is fine. That's what the learner roles are for, and incompetence is expected in them.
However, being purposefully incompetent or willfully ignorant to the point in which you are actively self-sabotaging, repeatedly making poor decisions, and overall reducing the fun of the round should be avoided.
[color=#1b67a5][bold]Command[/bold][/color] and [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] are held to higher behavioral standards due to the inherent weight of their actions on the round’s story [bold]and will have stricter enforcement of this rule[/bold]. You are expected to follow your respective job’s standard operating procedures as part of effortful roleplay. [color=#1b67a5][bold]Command[/bold][/color] especially are expected to act as leaders and role models for their staff.
## Precedents
- Don't purposefully throw or self-sabotage because you are committing to a bit. - Don't abandon your job and role, either for in-character reasons or by disconnecting without warning. - If you are a member of [color=#1b67a5][bold]Command[/bold][/color], a [color=#1e7f28][bold]Central Command Dignitary[/bold][/color], or an important role (such as an antagonist), please message in admin help (F1) before heading to cryosleep or disconnecting if you can. (If not possible, at least inform your teammates beforehand.) - Everyone has emergencies and may suddenly need to leave, but if you consistently have to leave without warning, you probably should refrain from playing roles like [color=#1b67a5][bold]Command[/bold][/color] or [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color].
